body: This 2024 Mercedes Sprinter 144 AWD conversion is built on the El Capitan tier and designed for travelers who want a compact van layout with premium off-grid capability, flexible sleeping space, and high-end comfort features. The 144 wheelbase keeps the van easier to maneuver while still offering a full interior build with an indoor shower, custom couch-to-bed system, pop top, upgraded storage, and seating for additional passengers.

With an 800Ah lithium battery system, 300W solar, undermount air conditioning, diesel heat, Starlink Mini connectivity, upgraded suspension, and a premium interior finish package, this build is made for extended travel, remote work, and comfortable adventure in a smaller Sprinter platform.
